bibl.title: Maternal Figures in the Stesichorean Blueprint: Althaea, Callirhoe and the Lille Queen.
bibl.note: 1. Introduction. - 2. Althaea: the retrieval of Meleager's mother from scraps (frr. 189; 191; 193 F.) [P. Oxy. LVII, 3876 (= MP3 1486.11; LDAB 3971), frr. 2; 4; 11b]. - 3. Callirhoe, Geryon's mother (17 F.): moulding the mater dolorosa type [P. Oxy. XXXII, 2617 (= MP3 1485.1; LDAB 3969), fr. 11]. - 4. The Lille woman's ῥῆσις (fr. 97, 201-231 F.): the interlaced role of a mother and a sovereign [P. Lille inv. 76a, col. ii + 73, col. i (= MP3 1486.1; LDAB 3975)]. - 5. Conclusion.
